text:
lee: Heads-up: noticed a chain of evictions in us-west2-rack7 over the last hour. GPUs show available but small pods keep getting bumped and we end up with 2-3 empty GPUs in the rack.

anu: any recent changes to preemption or scoring?

lee: yes, matt rolled burst-preempt-sensitivity=high yesterday to reduce tail latency for training jobs. pattern: scheduler selects nodes, preempts helpers in order, but preempted pods land on other racks causing churn.

matt: oof, that flag increases eviction aggressiveness for low-priority pods. didn't realize it would cascade with rack-aware placement.

scheduler-bot: alert: us-west2 rack7 fragmentation spike at 2026-04-12T14:10Z

ops-oncall: impact: ~4% more preempts, slight increase in scheduling latency for small pods. GPUs idle fraction up in rack7.

anu: quick mitigation: set burst-preempt-sensitivity=medium for us-west2 and enable preempt-jitter=enabled to spread revokes.

matt: rolling patch now to feature-gate just us-west2. also adding a random 0-15s jitter to preempt timing.

lee: logs snippet: 
```
I0412 14:08:12 preempt.go:214 preempt start pod=cache-pop-3 node=usw2-r7-n03 priority=low
I0412 14:08:14 scheduler.go:430 evict pod=cache-pop-3 target=node=usw2-r8-n02
I0412 14:08:27 preempt.go:214 preempt start pod=cache-pop-4 node=usw2-r7-n05 priority=low
```

matt: patch applied. canary to rack7 only. monitoring metrics: preemptRate, idleGpuByRack, preemptAgeHistogram.

ops-oncall: alert cleared for rack7 fragmentation (duration 12m). watching for regressions.

anu: followups: 1) add rack-aware preempt spreading in scheduler, 2) add cost telemetry for churn by rack, 3) add canary gating rule for preemptRate delta > 2% per 10m.

lee: note cost: we saw brief spot instance churn impacting billing by ~0.25% for the hour. include in postmortem.

matt: thanks all. reverting global high-sensitivity until rack-spreading landed. :thumbsup:
